# Text
GN. No. 114 (Contd)
GOVERNMENT NOTICE NO. 114 published on 15/5/2026
THE WATER RESOURCES MANAGEMENT ACT,
(CAP. 331)
________
NOTICE
________
(Made under section 37(1))
THE WATER RESOURCES MANAGEMENT (WAMI/RUVU BASIN WATER SOURCES
PROTECTED ZONES) (ESTABLISHMENT) NOTICE, 2026
Citation
1. This Notice may be cited as the Water Resources
Management (Wami/Ruvu Basin Water Sources Protected
Zones) (Establishment) Notice, 2026.
Establishment
2. The areas specified in the Schedule to this
Notice are hereby established as protected zones.
Prohibition
3. For the purpose of protection and conservation
of protected zones specified in paragraph (2), human
activities shall not be allowed on the land draining to or
above the boundaries of such protected zones.
_________

_________
(Made under paragraph 2)

Description and demarcation points of each water source protected zone are as shown below:
1. CHAGONGWE WATER SOURCE PROTECTED ZONE
GN. No. 114 (Contd)
The water source of the Chagongwe River is located in Chagongwe Village. This source is one of the
streams that pour its water into the Wami River and is located in Gairo District. The source is used
as the main source of water for Gairo Urban Water Supply and Sanitation Authority (GAUWASA).
The protected area is 91,033.1 Square Meters. The demarcation points of the protected zone are as
shown in the table and map below:

2. RUVU RIVER WATER SOURCE PROTECTED ZONE
The Ruvu River water source is located in Kisanga Stendi and Magogoni Villages. The source has
been demarcated in 2024 with a distance of 35 kilometers on the left side and 36 kilometers on the
right side. The source is bordered with the coordinates 381801 to 388460 Eastings and 9221173 to
9200993 Nothings. This source is one of the streams that pour its water into the Kidunda dam and is
located in Morogoro District. The source is used as the main source of water for the Rural Water
Supply and Sanitation Agency (RUWASA) and Dar es Salaam Water Supply and Sanitation
Authority (DAWASA) to supply water in Morogoro, Dar es Salaam and Pwani. The protected area
is 8,500,000 Square Meters. The demarcation points of the protected zone are as shown in the table
and map below:

3. MVUHA RIVER WATER SOURCE PROTECTED ZONE - MOROGORO
The Mvuha River water source is located in Mvuha Village in Morogoro District. The
source has been demarcated in 2024 in a distance of 20 kilometers on left and right sides.
The source is bordered with the coordinates 373709 to 387207 Eastings and 9203372 to
9198130 Nothings. This source is one of the rivers that pour its water into the Ruvu River.
The source serves as the primary water supply for the community of Mvuha and is also
extensively used for irrigation in the Tulo Irrigation Scheme. The protected area is
5,520,000 Square Meters. The demarcation points of the protected zone are as shown in the
table and map below:

4. RUVU RIVER WATER SOURCE PROTECTED ZONE - KIBAHA
The water source of Ruvu River at Kibaha is located in Ruvu, Duthumi, Kwala and Vigwaza Villages
in Morogoro and Kibaha Districts. The source has been demarcated in 2025 in a distance of 69
kilometers on the right side and 66 kilometers on the left side. The source is bordered with the
coordinates 443943 to 480853 Eastings and 9223403 to 9277563 Nothings. This source is one of the
rivers that pour its water into the Indian Ocean. The source has been used as the main source of water
supply in Morogoro, Dar es Salaam and Pwani. The protected area is 19,044,000 Square Meters. The
demarcation points of the protected zone are as shown in the table and map below:
